en: Black‑and‑white historic street view labeled "Graz. Glacisstraße." It shows a broad, tree‑lined avenue with tram tracks curving along a cobblestone road. On the right are multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with ornate facades; on the left is a promenade with bare trees, benches, and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. A tram and several people are visible in the distance.
